proposal: IG-07: gross heat rate <= 6,045 kJ/kWh at the GT load for 60 % plant net load.
question: From the PER-001 part-load table, 60 % plant net load (368 MW) needs about 378.5 MW gross, between 50 % and 60 % GT load, with an interpolated gross heat rate of about 6,020 kJ/kWh. Net that is about 6,190 kJ/kWh against PG-03 (6,250 kJ/kWh), a 1 % margin, and there is no IEC part-load guarantee. Please give a part-load gross heat rate guarantee with sliding-pressure operation.
response: IEC gives IG-07: power island gross heat rate <= 6,060 kJ/kWh at the GT load for 60 % plant net load, sliding pressure, SRC (expected about 6,000 kJ/kWh).
subject: Part-load heat rate cover for PG-03 (60 % plant load)
